actualCalls.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Production FINAL CONTACT KEY DRAWING for a death animation of this exact approved moss-backed soil-boar. Reference1 is the approved design in its locked 512x512 layout. Preserve the character's original proportions: short broad forehead WITHOUT a new tall head crest, small short muzzle, original cheek size and original torso oval dimensions and moss/tusk markings. Redraw the boar immediately after its strength has failed and its body has fallen to the floor. The same three-quarter camera and facing left. Foreknees have buckled; the near foreleg is loose and lies obliquely FORWARD along the floor with a connected elbow and hoof, the far foreleg folded beneath the chest; hindlegs collapse naturally outward beside the belly. The heavy ribcage and flank keep their solid original size while losing support. Chest and belly touch the ground, the head hangs lower and turns just enough for the LOWER CHEEK and side of snout to meet the floor. Fully closed eyes, slack asymmetrical ears, short tail limp and dropping instead of curled upright. A convincing weight-bearing failure and dead limp asymmetry, not an alert crouch or an orderly sleeping pose. Exactly one complete creature, all parts attached, no gore. Keep original art style, fur texture, highlights, outline and moss placement, no redesign. Whole character visible inside same fixed512 square canvas; contact plane remains y448 with transparent area below it. No floor drawing, no cast shadow, no particles, text, labels or animation grid. Genuine transparent alpha. This drawing is actual key-pose source for a hybrid animation, not a preview.
